nodes.label: ADR-001: Pin ML Libraries Like Production DB Drivers
nodes.rationale: After a routine pip install brought in transformers==5.8.0 and silently broke 3 of 4 VLMs, the team decided to pin all ML library major versions explicitly. A major-version bump requires a full VLM re-run before landing on main. trust_remote_code models are silently coupled to transformers minor versions and carry multiple independent dependency contracts not surfaced by any package manifest.
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: pin ml libraries like production db drivers

nodes.label: ADR-002: Per-Model Inference Dispatchers Pattern
nodes.rationale: HuggingFace trust_remote_code VLMs each ship their own non-unified inference API and cannot be served by a single Qwen-shaped code path. The dispatcher pattern (config-driven inference_style + lambda dispatch in annotate) is the right shape for adding non-Qwen-style VLMs. Even if some models are dropped, the pattern should be kept.

nodes.label: ADR-003: Final Empirical Pin transformers==4.49.0
nodes.rationale: 4.49.0 is simultaneously the floor (Qwen2.5-VL added in 4.49.0) and practical ceiling (4.50.0+ refactors break trust_remote_code VLMs). It is a singleton release hence exact == pin. Three per-model monkeypatches were needed: dtype cast for Molmo, ndarray normalize coercion for MiniCPM-V, and _patch_qwen2_init_weights_for_bnb for MiniCPM-o.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Model-Major Batch Orchestration with DB-Driven Resumability
nodes.rationale: RTX 5080 Laptop has 15.92 GB VRAM; each VLM in bnb 4-bit peaks at 7-9 GB. No two models fit simultaneously. Model-major (outer loop = models, inner = images) means N_models x 1 cold-load cost vs N_models x N_images for image-major. Resumability uses UNIQUE(run_id, model_id) constraint as the only state — no separate progress file, no journal.
nodes.norm_label: adr-004: model-major batch orchestration with db-driven resumability
